component: Interactive Conic with rational shape previews, Apex/Vertical, tangent and perpendicular endpoints, curve/edge capture and temporary SubCrv inputs
implementation: Replace the old positional-only Conic command with a modular transport-independent input state. Preserve Default and leading/inline Apex script compatibility. Reuse existing exact NurbsCurve::try_conic and try_conic_through_point constructors; remove the rounded-rectangle duplicate rational constructor in favor of the same kernel.

Support 3D start/end/apex inputs, shape-point projection, numeric rho, an initially absent rho default, remembered successful rho across Undo, and Apex-first input with the end constrained to the apex CPlane-Z line by Vertical.

Capture immutable source curves or surface edges. Project endpoints onto their source, constrain apexes to tangents or tangent-cross-CPlane-normal lines, and infer a two-constraint apex by line intersection. A zero perpendicular direction leaves the apex free; incompatible lines fail atomically.

Reuse the common SubCrv point-order and length helpers and directed curve trimming, including the usd-brep backend when enabled. Temporary curves remain outside the document. Free length entry takes a direction confirmation point. Enter and the local FullCurve alias restore the original captured curve.

Connect viewport curve/edge selection, component choices, constrained point resolution, drafting planes, exact previews and stale-reference validation. Commit one public Conic command; preserve sources, reject invalid rho for correction, and discard failed shape constructions without helper objects.

Share public curve-primitive capture and exact document-state snapshots with Rectangle. Keep the existing legacy conic oracle operation and fixtures intact; expose the getter/history recipe as conic_command.

native_capture.method: Fresh authored public Conic commands in an owned private display, public RhinoCommon NURBS/segment and length queries, exact EndCommand success events and macro return, source CRCs, and actual Undo/Redo. No Cancel tail, unknown command or invalid input in qualifying histories. No proprietary implementation inspected or decompiled.

document: actual native Undo/Redo return and restoration

independent_length_control.capture_scope: Unmodified selected row from the initial 42-workflow capture using the default length query.
independent_length_control.derivation: For x(t)=30t-20t^2, the reversal is at t=3/4, x=11.25. Total variation is 11.25+(11.25-10)=12.5.
independent_length_control.policy: Retain the original native query as a control. Tighten the public measurement query, preserving the comparison epsilon and exact production geometry.

both endpoint constraints and mixed kinds

frontend: yield reference picker to another command

limitations: The complete Conic command is not qualified. Native surface-edge interactions and locked SubCrv direction remain outside the captured corpus.
Free numeric temporary length input uses a confirmation point; native interactive cursor-side and selection details are not exhaustively matched. FullCurve is a local alias.
Automatic acceptance of preselected reference curves and exhaustive snapping, near-degenerate and extreme-scale combinations remain unqualified.
Performance parity and live dependency history are not claimed.
